records.title: CA18103 - Adult Skills Fund Course Delivery
records.description: East Durham College is seeking to appoint a maximum of three high-performing subcontract partners to deliver Adult Skills Fund (ASF) provision at Level 2 and above, with a clear focus on progression into sustained employment and higher-level learning. Provision must be delivered to adults aged 19+ resident within the North East Mayoral Strategic Authority Delivery may take place in community, employer, or college venues, but learner residency must align with NECA postcode eligibility. The contract value will be based on an 80/20 split. The full contract value will be a maximum of £450,000 Tenderers are invited to bid for the contract amount they can effectively deliver within the specified contract requirements; it will then be at the discretion of the College to determine the split of the contract award. This may be split as incremental awards throughout the academic year dependent on achievement of deliverables. Includes Lots: Lot 1: Adult Skills Fund Course Delivery (1) Lot 2: Adult Skills Fund Course Delivery (2) Lot 3: Adult Skills Fund Course Delivery (3) To access this competition: Registered: Login to https://suppliers.multiquote.com and view the opportunity CA18103. Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18103 as the reason for registration. Any queries please contact MultiQuote on 020 3920 8054.

records.title: Short Term & Reablement Services (SRS)
records.description: This contract is a Call-off from the Help 2 Live at Home Framework (Reference: AS24587) SRS is a short- term enablement domiciliary care service offering timely support for individuals who may have an eligible Care Act need. The service will support individuals within their own home through the provision of packages of personal care whilst individuals await an assessment under the Care Act (2014). This service will not meet the needs of those individuals who require a primary health provision and or those who meet the criteria for an established health pathway. However, the Service Provider will be expected to be able to meet the needs of individuals in terms of supporting or administering medication in line with the prescriber's recommendations, and work alongside any health provisions which may wrap around the individuals core social care delivery to ensure a joined up approach to safe and effective discharge from hospital.
